text:
julia.markus: Heads-up — noticed a recurring 404 in the onboarding flow. The runtime guide links to /kb/kv-cache#prefetch but that anchor returns 404 in staging. Can someone with ownership take a quick look?
kevin.zhang: I saw that too yesterday during a smoke test. Likely an anchor rename in the kb page. I can open a tiny PR to re-add the anchor or update the link.
aria.devex: thanks for flagging. tagging @kevin.zhang since he touched the guide last week. If it's a one-line frontmatter or anchor tweak, a quick PR + merge should be fine. :+1:
kevin.zhang: plan: 1) find canonical heading in the kv-cache page, 2) update link in runtime guide, 3) run quick link-check job. I'll post the branch in a minute.
julia.markus: sounds good. If you want me to review, ping me when PR is up — low priority but would like it in the next deploy window.
kevin.zhang: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4821 — updates anchor and adds a short redirect note. Diff is 5 lines.
mike.sre: small note: if the production redirect layer relies on exact anchors, we might want to add a short redundant anchor to the kb page to avoid future breakage. I can add a tiny snippet in the staging job to catch anchor diffs in the link-checker.
kevin.zhang: good call @mike.sre. I'll keep the old anchor as an HTML anchor in the kb page (two anchors pointing to same section) and add a brief comment in the markdown so it doesn't get removed by later edits.
aria.devex: QA ask: can the link-check run on the branch preview? If so we can automate the smoke test before merge.
kevin.zhang: yes, link-check runs on previews. I triggered it, output looks green except for the original broken link (expected). Command I used: `./tools/link-checker --target=preview --path=runtime/guide`
docs-bot: link-checker completed for branch 4821 — 1 warning: legacy anchor matched by fallback alias. No broken external links.
julia.markus: review done, left one nit: add a tiny inline comment about why the redundant anchor exists.
kevin.zhang: updated. @julia.markus I moved the comment into the HTML anchor block. Ready for merge.
aria.devex: merging during tomorrow morning deploy window? That avoids immediate staging churn.
mike.sre: fine with that. I'll keep an eye on runtime onboarding traffic after deploy and watch for link-check regressions.
julia.markus: thanks everyone. small follow-up: can we add a one-sentence note to the docs maintainers doc about preserving legacy anchors when renaming headings? It's an easy policy to prevent this class of 404s.
kevin.zhang: will do — adding a quick PR against docs-maintainers.md after lunch.
aria.devex: sweet. closing the loop: thanks @kevin.zhang for the PR and @mike.sre for the extra guardrail idea. :heart:
